d:
Lucknow ke St. George’s medical hostel ka Room 309, jahan rehne wale students ke saath hoti hain kuch khaufnaak ghatnayein. Jab Rohit ko ek jala hua note milta hai aur sheeshe mein dikhai deti hai ek jali hui nurse ki parchhaai, toh woh ek aise raaz tak pahunchta hai jo 1857 ke daur se juda hai. Eleanor Mayfield ki dardnaak kahaani aur uski maut ke peeche chhipe sach ko jaankar Rohit samajh jaata hai ki uska saamna kisi aam aatma se nahi hai.
Aakhir Room 309 mein aisa kya hua tha ki aaj bhi wahan se aati hai jalne ki boo aur ek awaaz kehti hai, “Mujhe woh aag yaad hai”?
Dekhiye Sannata
